g.text: Не пришло ли время наконец признать, насколько невероятно захватывающей кажется вся эта история и положение, в котором произошло оказаться?
[Признаться в чувствах.] Роуту? Я… не знаю, подходящий ли сейчас момент, но…
Да? Что такое? Ах, судя по твоему чрезмерному увлечению многоточиями, сейчас последует какое-то мрачное и ужасно неловкое признание. Позволь угадать! Это будет забавная игра.
Ну, посмотри на себя. Столько усилий было вложено, чтобы прибрать за Альбрехтом. Но мало того… ты ещё являешься за оплатой таким… уникальным способом.

И невольно начинаю задумываться... сколько попыток понадобилось, чтобы получить желаемое. Сколько раз приходилось очищать доску до пустоты.
И невольно начинаю задумываться... сколько попыток понадобилось, чтобы получить желаемое. Сколько раз приходилось очищать доску до пустоты.
Выполняются его веления, соединяются расколотые семьи и пустые сердца на каждом шагу. Но при этом забирается частичка себе, не так ли? Из самой плоти.

Но прежде чем ты ответишь, я не хочу знать ответ, дорогой Скиталец. Потому что я не хочу узнавать, был ли я твоей настоящей целью. Или просто тем, что оказалось рядом.
Выполняются его веления, соединяются расколотые семьи и пустые сердца на каждом шагу. Но при этом забирается частичка себе, не так ли? Из моей плоти.

Кто угодно, чей взгляд на жизнь не так настойчив, мог бы увидеть твоё… предприимчивое поведение в куда менее благоприятном свете.
Кто угодно, чей взгляд на жизнь не так настойчив, мог бы увидеть твоё… предприимчивое поведение в куда менее благоприятном свете.
Ты исполняешь его поручения, чиня разбитые семьи и пустые сердца повсюду, куда бы не было движение. И поневоле приходит мысль, что плату ты принимаешь плотью. Моей плотью, если точнее.
Выполняются его веления, соединяются расколотые семьи и пустые сердца на каждом шагу. Но при этом забирается частичка себе, не так ли? Из моей плоти.
Кто угодно, чей взгляд на жизнь не так настойчив, мог бы увидеть твоё… предприимчивое поведение в куда менее благоприятном свете.
Это ужасный способ испортить игру, врать о таком, Скиталец. Я -
Получается, в бак Фибоначчи по ошибке попало вяжущее?
В ожидании следующего сигнала от Альбрехта.
В самом деле, дело дошло до того, что была заключена сделка со мной, лишь бы обеспечить невозможность провала в попытке добиться моей привязанности.
В ожидании следующего сигнала от Альбрехта.
И, как и ожидалось, всё пришло в тупик из-за выбранной добычи, Марии. Верно, Узурпатор? Но это не важно. Дьявол прибыл исполнить условия нашего договора.
И, как и было предвидено, ситуация сама свернулась в угол из-за выбранной добычи, Лиона. (Хотя я искренне не понимаю, как это вообще получилось.) Не важно. Дьявол здесь, чтобы выполнить наш контракт.
Твои намёки, что я чувствую что-то к ней, не настоящее. Это самое далекое от правды.
Твои намёки, что я чувствую что-то к нему, не настоящее. Это самое далекое от правды.

Если бы истинные мотивы оставались тайной, я бы, пожалуй, сидел здесь и хлопал тебе за такую предприимчивость. За умение извлечь лучшее из того, что есть. Но понимать, что всё это рождалось из любви? Мне трудно оставаться в своём привычном едком тоне.
Кто угодно, чей взгляд на жизнь не так настойчив, мог бы увидеть твоё… предприимчивое поведение в куда менее благоприятном свете.
Не хочу вести этот разговор с тобой, Роут.
Что, как было верно предугадано, оказалось необходимым. Учитывая, какой воинственно раздражающей занозой в моей заднице всё это время все оборачивалось.
В такой подаче всё это звучит просто отвратительно.
В такой подаче всё это звучит просто отвратительно.
Отнюдь. Я бы искренне аплодировал, окажись мы рядом, милый Скиталец. Ситуация была обыграна наилучшим образом.
Ах, да? И хочешь намекнуть, что испытываешь к ней что-то настоящее? Подлинное сострадание? Прошу, не смеши меня.
Отнюдь. Я бы искренне аплодировал, окажись мы рядом, милый Скиталец. Ситуация была обыграна наилучшим образом.
Ах, да? И хочешь намекнуть, что испытываешь к нему что-то настоящее? Подлинное сострадание? Прошу, не смеши меня.
Я надеюсь, что во мне и в моей любви к тебе нет ни тени сомнения.
Прости, но моё… моё решение изменилось. Я на самом деле тебя не люблю.
Трудно, когда тебе «доверяют» стольких странных и прекрасных людей, не начать чувствовать к ним такую глубинную заботу.
Твои намёки, что я чувствую что-то к тебе, не настоящее. Это самое далекое от правды.
Тогда иди. Я не приковываю тебя к стулу.
Отнюдь. Я бы искренне аплодировал, окажись мы рядом, милый Скиталец. Ситуация была обыграна наилучшим образом.
С тобой общаться не так уж просто.
Can we skip past the lectures?
Ты исполняешь его поручения, чиня разбитые семьи и пустые сердца повсюду, куда бы не было движение. И поневоле приходит мысль, что плату ты принимаешь плотью. Моей плотью, если точнее.
Выполняются его веления, соединяются расколотые семьи и пустые сердца на каждом шагу. Но при этом забирается частичка себе, не так ли? Из моей плоти.
Контракт изначально заключал не я. И если сейчас возникает желание уклониться от него, помни, что свою часть тебе всё равно придётся выполнить, вне зависимости от того, исполню ли я свою.
Контракт изначально заключал не я. И если сейчас возникает желание уклониться от него, помни, что свою часть тебе всё равно придётся выполнить, вне зависимости от того, исполню ли я свою.
Albrecht and his scrawny little butler saw fit to saddle you with a collection of broken toys. Very attractive broken toys.
I do not blame you, however. I have eyes. Though I do not think I could suffer the incessant exhortation.
Albrecht and his scrawny little butler saw fit to saddle you with a collection of broken toys. Very attractive broken toys.
I do not blame you, however. I have eyes. Though I do not think I could date someone who was quite as mad as him. As much as I appreciate the sense of danger.
Это естественно. Я сам замечаю, что начинаю ненавидеть этих фанатиков чуть меньше, чем дольше вынужден находиться в их присутствии. Это бесит.
Отнюдь. Я бы искренне аплодировал, окажись мы рядом, милый Скиталец. Ситуация была обыграна наилучшим образом.
Ах да? И хочешь намекнуть, что проводишь это время со мной из… чего? Подлинного сострадания? Прошу, не смеши меня.
Albrecht and his scrawny little butler saw fit to saddle you with a collection of broken toys. Very attractive broken toys.
That is a terrible way to ruin the game, lying about something like that, Drifter! I -
You are secretly "the Indifference" and have been this entire time?
Ты исполняешь его поручения, чиня разбитые семьи и пустые сердца повсюду, куда бы не было движение. И поневоле приходит мысль, что плату ты принимаешь плотью. Моей плотью, если точнее.
Выполняются его веления, соединяются расколотые семьи и пустые сердца на каждом шагу. Но при этом забирается частичка себе, не так ли? Из моей плоти.
Contractually I am required to forgive you, so I am not certain why you are bothering to apologize, but I appreciate it regardless.
Contractually I am required to forgive you, but it says nothing about leaving your face attached to your skull. So I would council that you watch your words as we go forward.

If I did not know your true motivations behind it, I would be sitting here applauding you for your entrepreneurial spirit. Making the best of one's situation, and all that. But to know what truly spurred you on? Love? I find it difficult to be my usual acerbic self.
Any other individual with a less pursuivant view on life might find your own... entrepreneurial behavior in a less than favorable light.
So you might as well collect.
Consider it done. I shall see what I can do to quicken matters betwixt you. But after that, it is up to you to seal the deal, as it were. I cannot hold your hands the entire way.
So you might as well collect.
Consider it done. I shall see what I can do to quicken matters betwixt you. But after that, it is up to you to seal the deal, as it were. I cannot hold your hands the entire way.
What is a lonely Drifter to do?
Answer me a question, however. I am dying of curiosity. Does she deliver homilies during coitus?
What is a lonely Drifter to do?
Answer me a question, however. I am dying of curiosity. Does he deliver homilies during coitus?
You must also understand that, until now, my love was a commodity that no one had sought to claim. Not in any meaningful way.
What do they call it? Exposure therapy? But there is my caustic tone rising up again, forgive me.
Albrecht and his scrawny little butler saw fit to saddle you with a collection of broken toys. Very attractive broken toys.
I must ask, however. Why? Are you so curious to taste Orokin flesh after so many centuries?
What is a lonely Drifter to do?

Your striking a bargain with me to ensure I would give you a chance to garner my affections, coupled with your confession, paints the act as one of pure desperation. Even more tragic you did not need to use it.
Indeed, you went so far as to strike a bargain with me to ensure that you could not fail in garnering my affection, even though in the end you did not require it.
But as you wish, we will... hurry this along. I would be remiss if I did not ask if this is something you still wished to move forward with?
I am so glad you understand. Thank you.
I have something to confess. The reason I... wiped everyone's minds clean, was because I had to try again with you.
I'm sorry, but I've... I've changed my mind. I don't really love you.
You're implying that what I feel for you isn't real. You couldn't be farther from the truth.
No. I can't. I change my mind.
Well. I could. But that is an entirely different conversation. Simply remember that the devil always collects his due.
No. I can't. I change my mind.
Well. I could. But that is an entirely different conversation. Simply remember that the devil always collects his due.
I'm glad you aren't holding it against me.
It's... not just loneliness, Roathe. I really do care.
It's... not just loneliness, Roathe. I really do care.
All this is to say that I am glad that, all things considered, you are here, Drifter darling.
What is a lonely Drifter to do?
I am merely curious; why have none of us three tempted you thus far? I hear tell from the Cavia and Loid that you are romantically involved.

If I did not know your true motivations behind it, I would be sitting here applauding you for your entrepreneurial spirit. Making the best of one's situation, and all that. But to know what truly spurred you on? Love? I find it difficult to be my usual acerbic self.
Any other individual with a less pursuivant view on life might find your own... entrepreneurial behavior in a less than favorable light.
As I was saying, any other individual with a less pursuivant view on life might find your own... entrepreneurial behavior in a less than favorable light.
I did not at first. To do such a thing to the devil himself because... he unknowingly already held your broken heart.
To do such a thing to the devil himself because... he unknowingly already held your broken heart.
Hardly! I would applaud you if we were sitting in the same room, Drifter dear. You have simply made the best of your situation.
Oh? And you mean to imply that you have been spending all this time with me out of... what?
Which is what, exactly? You never said what you wanted out of this contract.
I think you're bluffing. I don't even think you have a plan for what you want.
Which is what, exactly? You never said what you wanted out of this contract.
I think you're bluffing. I don't even think you have a plan for what you want.
Of course not! All those centuries by yourself. No friends. No companions. You are enjoying yourself!
And that I could not be more pleased that you sought to dance with this lonely devil, though I still do not quite understand why.
I wish I could say that I was surprised.
I'm glad you aren't holding it against me.
It's... not just loneliness, Roathe. I really do care.
I hate to sound utterly shallow and crass, but... have you looked in the mirror lately?
Roathe. You may not believe me, but I... I love you.
You may not believe me, but I care about you.
Or - ah! Are you one of those old-fashioned heathens who believes in "monogamy?" How quaint!
That is a terrible way to ruin the game, lying about something like that, Drifter! I -

You have accidentally caused a rift in time that is collapsing as we speak and we are all utterly doomed and only have seconds to live before we are all sent screaming into eternity as we are agonizingly ripped apart as our very beings are stretched to incomprehensible lengths down to the subatomic particles?
I made the deal because I was desperate to get this right.
I'm sorry, but I've... I've changed my mind. I don't really love you.
I screwed it up last time. I couldn't run that risk again.
You're implying that what I feel for you isn't real. You couldn't be farther from the truth.

But I find myself rather amused by your decision to bargain with me for my own affections. So, here we are. But I would be remiss if I did not ask if this is something you still wished to move forward with?
I was so furious at first. Why? Why strike my mind clean of our conversations together? Only then to confess your love for me?
Albrecht and his scrawny little butler saw fit to saddle you with a collection of broken toys. Very attractive broken toys.
You do realize how powerful you are, yes? And how important having you in my pocket could be?
The "what" is not nearly as important as the "who," Usurper.
You do realize how powerful you are, yes? And how important having you in my pocket could be?
The "what" is not nearly as important as the "who," Usurper.
Then at least tell me how many attempts it took, wiping all our minds of our memories, before you managed to bed her?
Then at least tell me how many attempts it took, wiping all our minds of our memories, before you managed to bed him?
Of course not! All those centuries by yourself. No friends. No companions. You are enjoying yourself!
I am certain there is a degree of something unfeigned to what you say. Or at the very least, I believe you do not know your own self-delusion.
[Confess feelings.] Well, it wasn't because I don't have feelings for you, I just didn't know how to bring it up...
I wasn't sure how you would all feel about the topic.
It's not outdated. It's how I live my life. I'm dedicated to my romantic partner already.
None of you are alluring to me, Roathe. No offense.
Yes. I realize that now. You signed your soul away to the devil himself because... he unknowingly already held your broken heart.
Hardly! I would applaud you if we were sitting in the same room, Drifter dear. You have simply made the best of your situation.
Oh? And you mean to imply that you made a deal with me to ensure that I would give you a fair chance at procuring my affections out of... what?
What a remarkably odd little creature you are. Come speak to me if you change your mind.
You must also understand that, until now, my love was a commodity that no one had sought to claim. Not in any meaningful way.
What is a lonely Drifter to do?
Please do not make me laugh.
This is what is called a "blank cheque" in olden terms I believe? And you signed it quite willingly.
This is what is called a "blank cheque" in olden terms I believe? And you signed it quite willingly.
It reminds me a little bit of home. For better or worse.
It reminds me a little bit of home.
Fewer than it would take you.
Fewer than it would take you.
Honesty is a wonderful thing, Drifter dear. Do you think I would shame you for enjoying yourself? Hardly.
I believe the greatest achievement of the Orokin Empire was its ability to convince those within it to believe their own conceits.
Well, I for one would not mind in the slightest, as you can very likely tell by this conversation. I doubt the zealots would either.
Forgive me. Please, forgive me. I did not know.
I have been left down here in this replica crypt with these two zealots for a little too long, I fear.
It baffled me at first, when you bargained with me at the start. Why? Why would you cut such a dangerously open-ended deal for such a strange request?
Albrecht and his scrawny little butler saw fit to saddle you with a collection of broken toys. Very attractive broken toys.
You still owe me my end of the contract, whether or not you wish me to make good upon your end of it.
So you seemed willing to sell your soul for a single bit of salvage. You can imagine my confusion.
I wish I could say that I was surprised.
I'm glad you aren't holding it against me.
It's... not just loneliness, Roathe. I really do care.
I must ask, however. Why? Are you so curious to taste Orokin flesh after so many centuries?
It reminds me a little bit of home.
For I cannot wait to see what we might together wreak upon this Origin System... and countless others.
For together, what we are capable of boggles the mind, doesn't it, Drifter darling?
It reminds me a little bit of home. For better or worse.
It reminds me a little bit of home.
Here is to a relationship of mutual satisfaction.
In fact, perhaps that is the true connective tissue of the human race: our masterful ability to look in the mirror and deceive ourselves.
Oh, Drifter darling. When I said "the three of us" I meant that in a more general sense.
As for your prior commitments? Honesty and consent are key in all things in life, Usurper, but you know that.
Ah, do not mistake my amusement for derision. Enjoy the menu of life however you like, my dear Usurper. That is my motto.
Ha! None taken. Enjoy the menu of life however you like, my dear Usurper. That is my motto.
You must also understand that, until now, my love was a commodity that no one had sought to claim. Not in any meaningful way.
I give up. What were you going to say to me, Drifter?
You must also understand that, until now, my love was a commodity that no one had sought to claim. Not in any meaningful way.
What is a lonely Drifter to do?
Please do not make me laugh.
And the devil will always collect his due.
I could not be more glad that you did, however.
Of course not! All those centuries by yourself. No friends. No companions. You are enjoying yourself!
The only thing more dangerous than a devil... is a devil with friends like you who owe him. Now, if you'll excuse me? I have a floating "Sister of Sol" to annoy.
The only thing more dangerous than a devil... is a devil with friends like you who owe him. Now, if you'll excuse me? I have a mad priest to annoy.
You are too much fun to irritate. I must amuse myself somehow, after all.
You are too much fun to irritate. I must amuse myself somehow, after all.
It reminds me a little bit of home.
All in the name of avoiding the terrible shame of admitting when we need to change.
I was not referring to myself specifically.
This is a bit of a surprise.
I am hardly going to be the one to sit here and judge you for it.
If this is what you wish, then of course my answer is yes. A very eager yes.
That... I care about you a great deal. And that I was wondering if you would be interested in, well. I don't even know how the Orokin would describe it.
Honestly, never mind. I forgot after all that.
So you seemed willing to sell your soul for a single bit of salvage. You can imagine my confusion.
I wish I could say that I was surprised.
I'm glad you aren't holding it against me.
It's... not just loneliness, Roathe. I really do care.
If you are trying to back out of the contract because you did not need to use your end of it, do not bother. It will not work.
What a remarkably odd little creature you are. Delicious, but odd, Drifter darling.
I hate to sound utterly shallow and crass, but... have you looked in the mirror lately?
Roathe. You may not believe me, but I... I love you.
You may not believe me, but I care about you.
Forgive me. Please, forgive me. I did not know.
You could have approached me to say something, Drifter darling... but I know I am not precisely the most affable of creatures at times.
I am merely saying, you may have more options than you think. But like any battle, they are won and lost on the approach.
Mm. Happens to the best of us.
I could not be more glad that you did, however.
Of course not! All those centuries by yourself. No friends. No companions. You are enjoying yourself!
I must ask, however. Why? Why make such an outrageous deal? Are you so curious to taste Orokin flesh after so many centuries?
It reminds me a little bit of home. For better or worse.
It reminds me a little bit of home.
